Welcome to Wish Island—a tropical paradise where every desire can come true... if you're horny enough!
Mischievous demoness Lulu on your shoulder is determined to turn you into the ultimate seducer. With her sexy magic tricks and naughty mind games, you'll learn how to charm the hottest girls on the island and unlock wild, unforgettable sex-adventures!

So fasten your seatbelt, lover-boy, Wish Island is waiting!

KEY FEATURES

SEDUCTION LESSONS FROM A REAL DEMONESS

Meet Lulu—your cheeky, magical wing-girl. She's ready to teach you how to melt girls' hearts. Time travel? Mind tricks? She's got your back, so get ready for the hottest sex adventure in your life!

FLIRT. TOUCH. REPEAT.
Click your way through exciting encounters, build up intimacy, and seduce girls with unique personalities. Every click brings you closer to the climax!

UNLOCK SEXY STORIES

Dive into spicy scenes illustrated with stunning artwork. From sweet flirts to wild fantasies—every girl has her own story.

CAN YOU HANDLE THEM?

Two powerful and seductive boss girls await you on Wish Island. Prove you're worthy, break through their defenses, and unlock the most intense encounters of your adventure!
